## Environment
- **RomMP version**: (e.g., 0.3.1, from Settings)
- **RomM server version**: (e.g., 4.1.0)
- **Device**: (e.g., Anbernic RG556, Retroid Pocket 5, Pixel 8)
- **Android version**: (e.g., Android 13)
- **Server access**: (e.g., LAN over HTTP, reverse proxy with a public certificate, self-signed certificate)

## Affected area
Which part of the app is failing?

- [ ] Pairing and sign-in
- [ ] Browsing the library
- [ ] Playback
- [ ] Offline downloads
- [ ] Playlists and favorites
- [ ] Handheld or controller input
- [ ] Something else

## Bug Description
A clear description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Select '...'
3. Press '...'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

## Screenshots / Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or logcat output. Redact your server address and any
tokens before pasting logs.

## Additional Context
Anything else that narrows it down, such as whether it happens for every album or
only one, and whether the track plays in a browser pointed at the same server.
